items.title: 21.11 Duniya ka mausam aur Sooraj se tawanai ki muntaqili (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of global climate and energy transfer from the Sun (PDF 179-181).

blocks.text: Sooraj se milne wali energy duniya ke climate mein tabdeeliyan lane mein aham kirdar ada karti hai. Yahan hum mukhtasar dekhenge ke Sooraj ki energy zameen par kaise phailti (distribute hoti) hai, aur equator aur poles ke darmiyan na-barabar garmi hawa (atmosphere) mein kaise tabdeeliyan lati hai.

blocks.title: Earth's energy budget
blocks.text: Zameen ka energy budget zameen ki jazb ki hui Sooraj ki energy aur zameen ki wapas space mein bheji gayi (radiate ki gayi) energy ke darmiyan tawazun (balance) hai.

Yeh batata hai ke Sooraj ki kitni energy zameen tak aati hai aur us mein se kitni reflection (mun'akis hone) aur emission (kharij hone) se wapas space mein chali jati hai. Jab zameen thandi hoti hai to surface par zyada barf aur snow hoti hai. Barf chamakdar hai aur bohat si dhoop wapas space mein reflect kar deti hai, jis se zameen aur thandi ho jati hai. Lekin jab zameen garam hoti hai to barf pighalne lagti hai. Is se neeche ki gehre rang ki zameen aur samandar khul jate hain, jo zyada dhoop jazb karte aur kam reflect karte hain; nateeja: zameen aur garam hoti hai. Aane aur jane wali energy ke isi tawazun ko zameen ka energy budget kehte hain, aur yeh zameen ka temperature mustaqil rakhne mein aham hai. Fig. 21.12 zameen ke energy budget ka khaaka hai. Is mein dikhaya gaya hai ke dhoop zameen ki surface aur atmosphere tak kaise pohanchti hai. Sooraj se aane wali energy, zameen se infrared (garmi ki) radiation ki shakal mein jane wali energy ke barabar hoti hai. Jab tak yeh tawazun qaim rahe, zameen ka temperature waqt ke saath aik jaisa rehta hai. Lekin greenhouse gases (jaise carbon dioxide aur methane) infrared radiation ko qaid kar leti hain aur space mein jane nahi deti. Is wajah se zameen garam ho rahi hai; is masle ko global warming kehte hain.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Zameen tak aane wali Sooraj ki energy ka sirf taqreeban 70% zameen jazb karti hai; baqi badal, barf aur registani (desert) surfaces wapas space mein reflect kar dete hain. Is budget mein sirf 1% ka adam-tawazun (imbalance) bhi duniya ke temperature mein bari tabdeeli la sakta hai.

blocks.alt: EARTH'S ENERGY BUDGET. Dhoop seedhi zameen ki satah tak aati hai, aur aik shaakh badal tak (Absorption of Solar Radiation by Atmosphere). Satah se: Convection and Conduction, Evaporation aur Latent Heat, khala aur fiza ki taraf infrared. Fiza se: khala aur zameen ki taraf infrared. Labels: Energy Gain by Atmosphere, Energy Loss from Atmosphere, Energy Loss aur Energy Gain at Earth's Surface, khali dabbon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.12: zameen ke energy budget ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 21.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen hissa batata hai ke surface energy kaise khoti hai (convection aur conduction, evaporation se latent heat, aur infrared), aur daen hissa ke surface energy kaise pati hai (dhoop, aur atmosphere se wapas aane wali infrared). Khali dabbe kitab ne is liye chhore hain ke un mein energy ki miqdar likhi ja sake. Jab jazb ki hui dhoop space mein jane wali infrared ke barabar ho to temperature qaim rehta hai; greenhouse gases zyada infrared wapas zameen ki taraf bhejein to zameen garam hoti hai.
2. Poles aur Equator ke darmiyan energy ka adam-tawazun

Zameen ka climate system bunyadi taur par is baat se banta hai ke Sooraj ki energy us ki surface par barabar nahi phailti. Equator par dhoop seedhi aur tez parti hai; wahan garam hawa oopar uth kar low-pressure (kam dabao wale) ilaqe banati hai. Poles par dhoop tirchi aur kamzor parti hai; wahan thandi hawa neeche baithti hai aur high-pressure (zyada dabao wale) ilaqe bante hain. Energy ka yeh adam-tawazun duniya bhar ki hawa ki gardish (atmospheric circulation) chalata hai aur hawa ke patterns banata hai: equator ke qareeb trade winds, mid-latitudes (darmiyani arz-e-balad) mein westerlies, aur poles ke qareeb polar easterlies. Yeh hawayein ocean currents ke saath mil kar duniya bhar mein garmi dobara phailati hain. Lekin insanon ki chhori hui greenhouse gases is qudrati tawazun ko bigar rahi hain, jis se global warming barh rahi hai aur mausam ke patterns badal rahe hain. Figure 21.13 zameen ka yeh energy imbalance dikhata hai: equator ko seedhi dhoop milti hai aur poles ko tirchi (oblique), jis se garmi na-barabar hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Sooraj se mutawazi Sun's rays aik jhuki hui zameen par aati hain jis ke gird patli fiza hai. Beech wali shua par 'Sunlight Strikes Most Directly', oopar neeche wali par 'Low Angle of Incoming Sunlight'. Arz-e-balad ki lakeerein: Arctic Circle, 60 darje N, 30 darje N, Tropic of Cancer, Equator, Tropic of Capricorn, 30 darje S, 60 darje S, Antarctic Circle; North Pole aur South Pole.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.13: qutbon aur khat-e-istiwa ke darmiyan tawanai ka adam-tawazun (kitab ki Figure 21.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Equator ke qareeb dhoop seedhi parti hai, is liye utni hi roshni chhote area par girti hai aur zyada garmi deti hai. Poles ke qareeb roshni tirchi (low angle) aati hai aur bare area par phail jati hai. Kaali lakeerein 30 aur 60 darje latitude hain; safed dashed lakeerein Tropic of Cancer/Capricorn (23.5 darje) aur Arctic/Antarctic Circle (66.5 darje) hain. Kitab har label mein dono naam saath likhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Equator ko poles se har square metre par zyada Sooraj ki energy kyun milti hai?
blocks.explanation: Equator par dhoop taqreeban seedhi parti hai, is liye roshni chhote area par jama hoti hai. Poles par kam angle se parti hai, is liye wahi roshni kaheen bare area par phail jati hai (aur zyada atmosphere se bhi guzarti hai).

items: Energy budget: jazb ki hui dhoop = space mein jane wali infrared; tawazun to temperature mustaqil.
Barf dhoop reflect karti hai; pighalti barf se aur garmi; greenhouse gases infrared qaid karti hain (global warming).
Equator garam, poles thande: is farq se hawa chalti hai (trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies).
